research_scope: Restriction evidence audit for six canonical DLC-era PQ skills with null race_restriction: Reverse Shot, Variant Drive, Revenge Final Flash, Blaster Ball, Ray Blast, Gigantic Breaker.

records.name: Reverse Shot
records.race_restriction_finding: No direct race-specific CaC restriction was established by the reviewed current skill pages; retain canonical null rather than infer from the NPC/partner user list.
records.evidence: Current Xenoverse 2 skill reference page confirms identity, classification, PQ endpoint, and notable user(s). The reviewed pages do not state a CaC race restriction.
